labs/pg-welcome.title: Welcome to Retiam
labs/pg-welcome.description: A word, a curve, and a moving point welcome you to the documentation.
walkthrough: Retiam writes the title, draws a quadratic curve, and moves a point along that same curve. The camera stays still so the motion is easy to follow.
experiments: Change the curve's control-point height and update the point's quadratic expression to match.
